notes.title: Patch 4.0.3
notes.notes: [p]4.0.3 is a minor patch intended to facilitate 300% zooming on the UI, an increase in the maximum zoom by 100%. Additionally the Tavern Dice mini game bug fix ensures that the Foe will not re-roll needlessly after starting a round.[/p][list][*][p]Tavern Dice mini game bug fix[/p][/*][*][p]Zoom extension to 300%[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 4.0.2
notes.notes:
Supra-structural issues addressed, along with aesthetic improvements to the Tavern mini game.

- Improved story context surrounding desert scene
- Adjusted route scripting at the Island reliquary (on attempted quit), removing graceful default resolution
- Corrected video-audio initialization from false mute point (potential cause for partial initial inaudible dialogue)
- Removed duplicate mini game exit button on some mini-games
- Improved cross-faded ambience, 
- Tavern Dice Duel logic reformatting for random round lead ordering with associated banter
- Tavern Dice Duel UI general improvements to player dice aesthetic (removed perpetual wavering)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578576/d37ef6d90084503bf27096952b4dc21f2f79a40e.png[/img]

These changes are minor in detail but improve the story-flow, with smooth scene setting script adjustment and keeping the mini-game structure integral in a late game puzzle.

notes.title: 4.0.1 Patch
notes.notes:
Improving [b]game-quality[/b] experience, this patch adjusts and fixes; 

- a small typographical error
- a .wav conflict
- a path routing bug on death in the woodlands requiring a game restart upon dying.

4.0.1 is a minor patch which doesn't impact the scope and direction of the game, only correcting the few minor issues prevailing on release.

notes.title: Release is hours away!
notes.notes:
The Gamebook Ascensions v4 Alpha release is only hours away! 

The highly progressive [b]gamebook[/b] is setting a new milestone on indie game development, come along and leave your impressions, favorite scenes or discussion this [b]Wednesday 30th April '25[/b], and be first to check out the new Version 4. Fully setup with player inventory (and you actually own the relic/jewellery design to manufacture it if you want ~ it's in the EULA), 
Mini-game puzzles, and dice have all taken the Ascension Gamebook BETA (which has been in F2P@itch) to a whole new level, and sets a new benchmark on delivering in-game items from the pixel standards of the 80's to actually feasible works of art and production. 
This Alpha version is all made possible with the magnanimous Claude/xAI/GoogleStudio coding capable AI's. What started on Midjourney with Ink, has become an original game engine by [i]indie dev[/i] [b]Kudomos[/b], 

I welcome your game reviews!
